魅心 处决分镜
Boss Execution · v5 · 已生成

魅心CHARM-HEART — 她不打斗，只用一朵玫瑰

Boss 是一位贵妇。她靠瓶中的玫瑰魅惑猎物，让对方自己走过来跪下。她亲手取出那颗心，献给笼中巨心，再把空了心的人留作雕像。每件道具只有一个用途：玫瑰负责魅惑，巨心负责吸收，锁链负责供血，雕像负责陈列。

360 帧15 秒24 fps8 个镜头机位不越轴：女孩在画左，Boss 在画右

这一版改了什么

没有触手

她只用玫瑰的魅惑和自己的手。原画里没有的能力一个都不加。

道具不来回换

心只去巨心，幽灵始终跟着女孩。提灯和地上的罐子只当布景，全程不碰。

幽灵的故事线

它只会闪现：先在罐子里发抖，再闪出来拦路两次，被 Boss 一手扫开，又闪回主人肩上。主人石化时它躲回罐子，罐子一起变成铜，最后只剩裂缝里的一点蓝光。

镜头递进

全景 → 主观 → 眼睛特写 → 跟拍 → 逆光双人 → 中景 → 正面 → 升降大全景，由远到近再拉远。

提示词

全部用英文，写具体的形状和材质。每个镜头只写一个主要动作，写明机位和动作怎么收住，每条都带同一句画面基调。

分镜

左边是 AI 关键帧，右边是 Blender 灰模的机位。确认后才进入视频生成。

S1

注意

0.0–1.5s全景 · 低机位 · 缓推

动作

  • Boss 背靠鸟笼静立，女孩站在大厅中央。
  • Boss 的瓶头缓缓转向她：她注意到了猎物。

逻辑：先交代空间：巨心、雕像、锁链、灯罐全部入画，玩家一眼就能看清这里是她的收藏馆。

Wide low-angle shot of a gothic hall. A headless rose queen with a clear glass flask for a head stands still before a huge iron birdcage holding a giant glowing anatomical heart; bronze statues of women raise ice-blue hearts on both sides. A small white-bob girl with a ghost-tank backpack stands in the middle of the floor, seen from behind-left. The queen slowly turns her flask head toward the girl, then holds still. Camera: slow push-in. Dark gothic fairy-tale cinematic 3D CG, stylized characters, deep crimson and icy cyan contrast lighting, volumetric haze, anamorphic 35mm lens, shallow depth of field.
S2

魅惑

1.5–3.0s女孩过肩 · 推近瓶头

动作

  • 瓶里的真玫瑰一层层舒展盛放。
  • 红光随花瓣张开一明一暗地呼吸。

逻辑：她不动手，只靠玫瑰魅惑。这是全片唯一的「超能力」，而且原画里就有。

Over-the-shoulder from behind the girl's white bob, looking up at the queen's glass flask head. Inside the flask a single real red rose slowly unfurls into full bloom: velvety crimson petals open layer by layer, green sepals curl back, warm red light pulses through the glass three times, then settles bright. The queen stays motionless. Camera: slow push-in toward the flask. Dark gothic fairy-tale cinematic 3D CG, stylized characters, deep crimson and icy cyan contrast lighting, volumetric haze, anamorphic 35mm lens, shallow depth of field.
S3

失神

3.0–4.25s眼睛大特写

动作

  • 她的橙色螺旋瞳孔里映出盛放的玫瑰。
  • 眼皮慢慢垂下一半，眼神空了。

逻辑：用一个特写交代「她被魅惑了」，后面她自己走过去才说得通。

Extreme close-up of the girl's eyes under her white blunt bangs. Each orange spiral iris reflects a tiny glowing red rose. The spirals begin to turn slowly, her eyelids lower halfway, her gaze goes blank and dreamy, then holds. Soft red light on her face. Camera: static, very slight push-in. Dark gothic fairy-tale cinematic 3D CG, stylized characters, deep crimson and icy cyan contrast lighting, volumetric haze, anamorphic 35mm lens, shallow depth of field.
S4

走向她

4.25–6.5s侧面跟拍 · 中景

动作

  • 女孩像梦游一样走过去，双臂垂着。
  • 幽灵「啪」地闪现到她面前张开双手拦路，她直接穿过去；幽灵再闪到前面拦一次。
  • 她在 Boss 裙边跪下。

逻辑：幽灵只会闪现：它闪到主人面前张开手拦路，被主人直接穿过；再闪到前面拦一次，还是拦不住。

Side tracking medium shot. The entranced girl walks forward slowly like a sleepwalker, arms hanging limp, blank face. The small round white-blue ghost bursts out of her backpack glass tank, grabs the back of her hood with both tiny hands and pulls backward with all its strength, panicked, but is dragged along. She stops at the hem of the queen's rose-petal gown and sinks to her knees. Camera: tracks alongside left to right, then settles. Dark gothic fairy-tale cinematic 3D CG, stylized characters, deep crimson and icy cyan contrast lighting, volumetric haze, anamorphic 35mm lens, shallow depth of field.
S5

取心

6.5–8.5s低机位双人 · 巨心逆光

动作

  • 幽灵闪到女孩胸前挡着，Boss 看都不看，用手背一扫，它翻滚着摔到地上。
  • Boss 一根手指托起女孩下巴端详，再把掌心按上她胸口。
  • 红光从指缝透出，一颗水晶心滑进她掌心。

逻辑：Boss 根本不把幽灵当回事，这一扫交代了双方的实力差距。摘心全程用光表现，没有血。

Low-angle two-shot backlit by the glowing giant heart. The queen bends over the kneeling girl, first lifts the girl's chin with one long pale finger and tilts her flask head as if inspecting her, then presses her palm flat on the girl's chest. Red light leaks between her fingers and a glowing red crystal heart slides out of the chest into her palm. No blood. The little ghost hugs the girl's shoulder with its eyes squeezed shut. Camera: static, slight tilt up. Dark gothic fairy-tale cinematic 3D CG, stylized characters, deep crimson and icy cyan contrast lighting, volumetric haze, anamorphic 35mm lens, shallow depth of field.
S6

献心

8.5–10.5sBoss 侧后方 · 中景

动作

  • Boss 转身面向鸟笼，把手伸进笼栏。
  • 她把心按进巨心表面，巨心把它吞进去，重重一跳，红光扫过大厅，锁链震动。
  • 画面左侧，晕乎乎的幽灵闪回女孩肩上，拼命摇她。

逻辑：心只去一个地方：巨心。巨心变亮，直接说明她靠收集心脏供养它。

Medium shot from behind and to the side of the queen. She turns to the birdcage and reaches one arm between the iron bars, pressing the small glowing crystal heart into the surface of the giant anatomical heart; it sinks in like into wax. The giant heart beats once, hard, flaring bright, and a ring of red light sweeps across the hall; the chains tremble. The girl stays kneeling at left, the ghost clinging to her. Camera: static. Dark gothic fairy-tale cinematic 3D CG, stylized characters, deep crimson and icy cyan contrast lighting, volumetric haze, anamorphic 35mm lens, shallow depth of field.
S7

冷心 · 石化

10.5–12.75s女孩正面 · 中景

动作

  • 她空掉的胸口亮起冷蓝光，凝成一颗冰蓝心。
  • 她站起来，把蓝心举过头顶，姿势和所有雕像一样。
  • 暗青铜从脚往上爬，分界线有一道细红光。
  • 最后一刻幽灵闪回自己的罐子，那是它唯一的家，罐子随即和她一起变成青铜。

逻辑：被换走真心的人只剩一颗冷心。这句话就是两排雕像的来历。

Medium front shot of the girl. A cold blue glow kindles in her empty chest and forms an ice-blue crystal heart; she rises to her feet and raises it high above her head with her right arm, the same pose as the statues around her. Dark aged bronze climbs from her boots up her legs, body and hair, with a thin glowing red line at the boundary; finally the little ghost on her shoulder turns to bronze too. Only the blue heart keeps glowing. Camera: slow tilt up. Dark gothic fairy-tale cinematic 3D CG, stylized characters, deep crimson and icy cyan contrast lighting, volumetric haze, anamorphic 35mm lens, shallow depth of field.
S8

陈列

12.75–15.0s升降拉远 · 大全景

动作

  • 鸟笼里垂下一条新锁链，扣住新雕像的手腕。
  • 铜罐上有一道细裂缝，里面透出一点微弱的蓝光：幽灵还被封在里面。
  • Boss 滑回原位，巨心最后一跳，所有雕像手里的蓝心一起闪一下，淡出。

逻辑：锁链把她接进供血系统，大厅里多了一件藏品；裂缝里的蓝光是幽灵的结局，也给后续剧情留了钩子。

High crane shot pulling back to a wide view of the hall. The girl is now a small dark bronze statue holding an ice-blue heart aloft, a bronze ghost on her shoulder; a new iron chain uncoils from the birdcage and clasps her raised wrist. The rose queen glides silently back to her place beside the cage. The giant heart beats once and every statue's blue heart flickers at the same time, then the image fades to black. Camera: smooth crane up and back. Dark gothic fairy-tale cinematic 3D CG, stylized characters, deep crimson and icy cyan contrast lighting, volumetric haze, anamorphic 35mm lens, shallow depth of field.

成片（方法 A：Seedance 2.5 全能参考，一次生成 15 秒）

参考素材：8 张关键帧（按镜头顺序）、女孩三视图、模糊处理的灰模运动视频。成片文件：G119_魅心处决_v5_15s_1080p.mp4。

REFERENCES: @图片1 @图片2 @图片3 @图片4 @图片5 @图片6 @图片7 @图片8 are the keyframes of shots 1 to 8 in order; match each shot's composition, characters, costume and lighting to its keyframe. @图片9 is the girl's character sheet: keep her face, straight white bob with blunt bangs, orange spiral eyes, oversized dark grey hoodie, grey shorts, blue-grey socks and red boots identical in every shot. @视频1 is a deliberately blurred grey blockout: use ONLY its camera moves, cut timing and character blocking; never copy its blurry grey look.
CHARACTERS: The rose queen is headless; her head is a clear round glass flask holding one real red rose (velvety crimson petals layered in a spiral, green sepals, green thorny stem). She wears a tall gown of layered crimson rose petals with black thorny branches, has long pale fingers, and holds a small gold-framed glass cube lantern with a red heart in her right hand the whole time; the lantern never opens. She never uses tentacles or vines; she only uses her rose and her hands. The ghost is a small round white-blue glowing spirit with black oval eyes and tiny stubby arms; it never floats slowly, it moves ONLY by teleporting: it vanishes in a cyan flash and reappears instantly in a burst of cyan light sparks.
SHOTS (15 seconds, hard cuts):
Shot 1 (0-1.5s), wide low angle, slow push-in: the queen stands still before the giant birdcage holding a glowing anatomical heart; bronze statues of women raise ice-blue hearts on both sides; the girl stands in the middle of the hall; the ghost trembles inside her backpack glass tank. The queen slowly turns her flask head toward the girl, then holds still.
Shot 2 (1.5-3s), over the girl's shoulder, slow push-in on the flask: the rose inside unfurls into full bloom layer by layer, red light pulsing three times through the glass.
Shot 3 (3-4s), extreme close-up of the girl's eyes: each orange spiral iris reflects the glowing rose, the spirals start to turn, her eyelids drop halfway, her gaze goes blank.
Shot 4 (4-6.5s), side tracking shot: the entranced girl walks toward the queen like a sleepwalker, arms limp. The ghost teleports out of the tank with a cyan flash and appears in front of her, arms spread to block her; she walks straight through it; it teleports in front of her again; she still walks on and sinks to her knees at the hem of the queen's gown.
Shot 5 (6.5-8.75s), low-angle two-shot backlit by the giant heart: the ghost pops up in front of the girl's chest; without looking, the queen sweeps it aside with the back of her hand and it tumbles away across the floor, dazed. The queen lifts the girl's chin with one finger, tilts her flask as if inspecting her, then presses her palm on the girl's chest; red light leaks between her fingers and a glowing red crystal heart slides out into her palm. No blood.
Shot 6 (8.75-10.75s), medium shot from behind the queen: she turns to the birdcage, reaches between the bars and presses the crystal heart into the surface of the giant heart, which swallows it and beats once, hard; a ring of red light sweeps the hall and the chains tremble. At left the dazed ghost teleports back onto the kneeling girl's shoulder and shakes her.
Shot 7 (10.75-13s), medium front shot, slow tilt up: cold blue light forms an ice-blue crystal heart in the girl's empty chest; she rises and lifts it high above her head, the same pose as the statues. Dark aged bronze climbs from her boots upward with a thin glowing red line at the boundary; at the last moment the ghost teleports back into its glass tank, and the tank turns to bronze around it.
Shot 8 (13-15s), crane up and back to a wide shot: the girl is now a small bronze statue holding the glowing ice-blue heart, child proportions, bronze bob hair; a new iron chain from the birdcage clasps her raised wrist; a faint cyan light flickers from a thin crack in the bronze tank on her back. The queen glides back to her place beside the cage. The giant heart beats once, every statue's blue heart flickers at the same moment, fade to black.
LOOK: dark gothic fairy-tale cinematic 3D CG feature film, stylized characters, deep crimson and icy cyan contrast lighting, volumetric haze, anamorphic 35mm lens, shallow depth of field. Keep the same character designs in every shot. No text, no subtitles, no blood, no extra characters.
